name: @retroplug/mesen
description: The Mesen core's half of the app: the mesen core-config role every Mesen system carries (NES, GBA, SMS/GG) - region, sprite limit, FM, APU latency, the cartridge-accuracy switches, expansion volume, the per-channel export mode, the emulated N8's SD root, FIFO profile and reliable link, and driving a real cart - the settings enums its schema reads; and its native half, the three consoles, their build functions and the rp.mesen.nes / .gba / .sms nodes.
